description: Source code for H2BGraphicBufferProducer class, implementing buffer producer interface with transaction handling, buffer management, and communication with hardware buffers in Android graphics framework.

classes.name: H2BGraphicBufferProducer
classes.description: Implementation of a graphics buffer producer that communicates with hardware buffer interfaces, manages buffer lifecycle, and handles various buffer operations.

methods.name: requestBuffer
methods.description: Requests a buffer from the producer for a given slot, converting and returning the hardware buffer.

methods.name: setMaxDequeuedBufferCount
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of buffers that can be dequeued.

methods.name: setAsyncMode
methods.description: Enables or disables asynchronous mode for buffer production.

methods.name: dequeueBuffer
methods.description: Dequeues a buffer for writing, returning buffer slot, fence, and other info.

methods.name: detachBuffer
methods.description: Detaches a buffer from a slot.

methods.name: detachNextBuffer
methods.description: Detaches the next available buffer, returning buffer and fence.

methods.name: attachBuffer
methods.description: Attaches a buffer to a slot, returning the slot index.

methods.name: queueBuffer
methods.description: Queues a buffer for display with input parameters.

methods.name: cancelBuffer
methods.description: Cancels a buffer in a slot, signaling with a fence.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Queries information about the buffer producer.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the buffer producer with a listener and output info.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from the buffer producer.

methods.name: setSidebandStream
methods.description: Sets a sideband stream; not supported in this implementation.

methods.name: allocateBuffers
methods.description: Allocates buffers with specified dimensions and format.

methods.name: allowAllocation
methods.description: Allows or disallows buffer allocation.

methods.name: setGenerationNumber
methods.description: Sets the generation number for buffers.

methods.name: getConsumerName
methods.description: Retrieves the consumer name.

methods.name: setSharedBufferMode
methods.description: Sets shared buffer mode; not supported.

methods.name: setAutoRefresh
methods.description: Sets auto-refresh mode; not supported.

methods.name: setDequeueTimeout
methods.description: Sets timeout for dequeuing buffers.

methods.name: getLastQueuedBuffer
methods.description: Not supported.

methods.name: getFrameTimestamps
methods.description: Not supported.

methods.name: getUniqueId
methods.description: Retrieves a unique identifier for the producer.

methods.name: getConsumerUsage
methods.description: Not supported.
